name: exploded-portafilter-claude-haiku-5.5-s1-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an espresso machine portafilter, as an SVG. Use a double-spout portafilter with a removable basket rather than a bottomless one.

grade.detail: failed: parts, order; left to the eye: fit, labels

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="900" height="1100" viewBox="0 0 900 1100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="metal" x1="0" x2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9aa3ad"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#e4e8ec"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7d8792"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" x2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6b3e22"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#9a5f35"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#5a3219"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="900" height="1100" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <text x="450" y="45" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#222">Double-Spout Espresso Portafilter — Exploded Assembly</text>
  <text x="450" y="72" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#555">Exploded along the central axis; dashed line shows alignment</text>

  <!-- alignment axis -->
  <line x1="450" y1="95" x2="450" y2="860" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="10,6"/>

  <!-- 1. Handle -->
  <rect x="300" y="110" width="300" height="46" rx="23" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#2e1a0c" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="390" y1="112" x2="390" y2="154" stroke="#3b2110" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="430" y1="112" x2="430" y2="154" stroke="#3b2110" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="640" y="118" width="16" height="30" rx="3" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555"/>

  <!-- 2. Handle screws (two, pulled apart from handle) -->
  <g transform="translate(380,205)">
    <rect x="-9" y="-12" width="18" height="10" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555"/>
    <rect x="-4" y="-2" width="8" height="22" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(520,205)">
    <rect x="-9" y="-12" width="18" height="10" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555"/>
    <rect x="-4" y="-2" width="8" height="22" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 3. Body with collar, cup, rim, and double spouts -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="242" rx="55" ry="9" fill="#dfe4e9" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="395" y="242" width="110" height="28" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 395 270 L 395 360 Q 395 372 410 374 L 490 374 Q 505 372 505 360 L 505 270 Z" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="390" y="356" width="120" height="9" rx="3" fill="#b8c0c8" stroke="#555"/>
  <!-- double spouts -->
  <path d="M 396 362 L 350 372 Q 340 376 344 384 L 362 390 L 396 380 Z" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 504 362 L 550 372 Q 560 376 556 384 L 538 390 L 504 380 Z" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="352" cy="384" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#333"/>
  <ellipse cx="548" cy="384" rx="5" ry="2.5" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- 4. Removable basket -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="436" rx="66" ry="9" fill="#c9d0d7" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 384 436 L 393 510 Q 395 518 404 518 L 496 518 Q 505 518 507 510 L 516 436 Z" fill="#d7dde3" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="518" rx="46" ry="5" fill="#aab3bc" stroke="#555"/>
  <g fill="#4a5058">
    <circle cx="410" cy="455" r="2"/><circle cx="430" cy="455" r="2"/><circle cx="450" cy="455" r="2"/><circle cx="470" cy="455" r="2"/><circle cx="490" cy="455" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="420" cy="477" r="2"/><circle cx="440" cy="477" r="2"/><circle cx="460" cy="477" r="2"/><circle cx="480" cy="477" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="410" cy="499" r="2"/><circle cx="430" cy="499" r="2"/><circle cx="450" cy="499" r="2"/><circle cx="470" cy="499" r="2"/><circle cx="490" cy="499" r="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 5. Retaining ring -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="580" rx="58" ry="7" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 392 580 L 392 594 Q 392 601 450 601 Q 508 601 508 594 L 508 580 Z" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Callouts: all on the right, horizontal leaders -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#222" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1">
    <line x1="600" y1="133" x2="650" y2="133"/>
    <text x="665" y="138" stroke="none">1  Handle (wood, with metal end cap)</text>
    <line x1="530" y1="205" x2="650" y2="205"/>
    <text x="665" y="210" stroke="none">2  Handle screws (×2)</text>
    <line x1="505" y1="310" x2="650" y2="310"/>
    <text x="665" y="315" stroke="none">3  Portafilter body (collar, cup, rim)</text>
    <line x1="556" y1="384" x2="650" y2="384"/>
    <text x="665" y="389" stroke="none">3a  Double spouts (two pouring lips)</text>
    <line x1="516" y1="470" x2="650" y2="470"/>
    <text x="665" y="475" stroke="none">4  Removable filter basket (perforated)</text>
    <line x1="508" y1="580" x2="650" y2="580"/>
    <text x="665" y="585" stroke="none">5  Basket retaining ring</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer notes -->
  <text x="450" y="1000" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#555">Assembly order: insert basket into body cup, seat retaining ring, attach handle with screws to collar.</text>
  <text x="450" y="1020" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#555">Double spouts send espresso into two cups; basket is removable for cleaning and dosing.</text>
</svg>
